bio_text: Zhiyuan (Stiven) Ding is a Computer and Data Engineering graduate serving as CTO of Braillic, a Hong Kong-based medtech startup building augmented reality surgical navigation software. His background spans software engineering, machine learning, computer vision, cybersecurity, embedded systems, and IoT, with research experience at City University of Hong Kong. At Braillic, he works on the ArNav platform, which uses AI and AR to deliver real-time 3D anatomical guidance to surgeons.
